name: Bumper Bout
description:
About This Game

Bump about with Bumper Bout! A competitive pinball party game where two players share the same playfield. Earn points to launch balls to other’s sides and see who can last the longest. Battle across a mix of quirky and colorful arenas each bursting with hazards and surprises. Master every character’s unique Super Ball, a game changing power move that can turn the match in an instant. With solo challenges, local and online multiplayer, and huge replayability, Bumper Bout is easy to pick up and hard to put down and the perfect recipe for laughs, rivalry, and arcade fun.
short_desc: A multiplayer pinball party! Battle local or online across a mix of quirky and colorful arenas each bursting with hazards and surprises. Master every character’s unique Super Ball move to turn the tides at the last moment.
